simple.meaning: אַיִל (ʼayil) appears 196 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with flocks and in connection with priesthood. The occurrence trail connects the name with an offering.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, beginning at Genesis 15:9. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, flock, offering, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אַיִל (H352) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows אַיִל through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: אַיִל (ʼayil) / H352 is tracked through Genesis 15:9, Genesis 22:13, Genesis 31:38, Genesis 32:15. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.
